'Cone':['ARR3','GNAT2','PDE6C','PDE6H','CNGB3','OPN1SW','GUCA1C','THRB'],
'GABAamacrine':['GAD1','GAD2','SLC6A1','SLC32A1','DLX1','DLX2','TFAP2A','TFAP2B'],
'Horizontal':['LHX1','ONECUT1','ONECUT2','PROX1','CALB1','RELN','SEMA6A','EPHA7'],
'Microglia':['CX3CR1','P2RY12','C1QA','C1QB','C1QC','AIF1','TMEM119','TYROBP'],
'Mullerglia':['RLBP1','GLUL','SLC1A3','SLC1A2','SOX9','CLU','VIM','APOE'],
'Retinalganglioncell':['RBPMS','SNCG','POU4F1','POU4F2','NEFL','NEFM','ISL1','THY1'],
'Rod':['RHO','GNAT1','PDE6A','PDE6B','CNGA1','NRL','SAG','GNGT1']}
allgenes=sorted(set(sum(markers.values(),[])))
def one(g):
 u='https://mygene.info/v3/query'
 x=requests.get(u,params={'q':'symbol:'+g,'species':'human','fields':'symbol,genomic_pos','size':3},timeout=20).json()
 for h in x.get('hits',[]):
  if h.get('symbol')"'!=g: continue
  ps=h.get('"'genomic_pos',[]); ps=ps if isinstance(ps,list) else [ps]
  ps=[p for p in ps if str(p.get('chr')) in [str(i) for i in range(1,23)]+['X','Y']]
  if ps:
   p=ps[0]; t=p['start'] if p['strand']==1 else p['end']; return g,'chr'+str(p['chr']),t
 return g,None,None
with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=12) as ex:
 coords=dict((g,(c,t)) for g,c,t in ex.map(one,allgenes))
missing=[g for g,v in coords.items() if v[0] is None]; print('missing',missing)
df=pd.read_csv('sample.swap.atac.q2.tsv.gz',sep='\\t')
cols=list(df.columns[3:]); totals=df[cols].sum(); X=df[cols].div(totals,axis=1)*1e6
# indexes by tuple exact bin
idx={(c,int(s)):i for i,(c,s) in enumerate(zip(df.chrom,df.start))}
print('depths',totals.to_dict())
for typ,gs in markers.items():
 vals=[]
 print('\\n###',typ)
 for g in gs:
  c,t=coords[g]; start=(int(t)//10000)*10000
  ii=idx.get((c,start))
  if ii is None: continue
  v=X.iloc[ii]
  # specificity of counts in TSS bin
  top=v.sort_values(ascending=False).head(3)
  print(g,c,t,' '.join(f'{k}:{x:.2f}' for k,x in top.items()))

import gzip,csv,numpy as np
T=np.array([11836803,7530916,48403523,37015795,31640818,8155368,94395242,21014655,413545691.],float)
rows=[]
with gzip.open('sample.swap.atac.q2.tsv.gz','rt') as f:
 r=csv.reader(f,delimiter='\\t'); H=next(r)[3:]
 for q in r:
  x=np.array(q[3:],float)
  if x.sum()>0: rows.append(np.log1p(x/T*1e6))
X=np.stack(rows)
C=np.corrcoef(X.T)
print('bins',X.shape)
print(''.join(f'{h[:7]:>9}' for h in ['']+H))
for h,row in zip(H,C): print(f'{h[:7]:>9}'+''.join(f'{v:9.3f}' for v in row))
PY"
